problem.paragraph: Find the indicated limit if it exists.

list.item: $$\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow 3}\frac{\sqrt{x^{2} + 7} + \sqrt{3x - 5}}{x + 2}$$
$$\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{x^{2} - x - 2}{2x^{2} - x - 3}$$

solution.paragraph: Letting $$x$$ approach $$- 1$$ leads to the indeterminate form $$0 \slash 0$$ . Thus, we proceed as follows:

$$\begin{array}{l} {\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{x^{2} - x - 2}{2x^{2} - x - 3} = \lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{\left( {x + 1} \right)\left( {x - 2} \right)}{\left( {x + 1} \right)\left( {2x - 3} \right)}} \\ {\phantom{\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{x^{2} - x - 2}{2x^{2} - x - 3}} = \lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{x - 2}{2x - 3} { \text{Cancel the common factors} .}} \\ {\phantom{\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{x^{2} - x - 2}{2x^{2} - x - 3}} = \frac{- 1 - 2}{2\left( {- 1} \right) - 3}} \\ {\phantom{\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow - 1}\frac{x^{2} - x - 2}{2x^{2} - x - 3}} = \frac{3}{5}} \end{array}$$

problem.paragraph: Toxic Waste A city’s main well was recently found to be contaminated with trichloroethylene, a cancer-causing chemical, as a result of an abandoned chemical dump leaching chemicals into the water. A proposal submitted to city council members indicates that the cost, measured in millions of dollars, of removing $$x\%$$ of the toxic pollutant is given by

list.item: Find the cost of removing $$50\%$$ , $$60\%$$ , $$70\%$$ , $$80\%$$ , $$90\%$$ , and $$95\%$$ of the pollutant.
Evaluate $$\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow 100}\frac{0.5x}{100 - x}$$ and interpret your result.

solution.paragraph: $$\$ 0.5$$ million; $$\$ 0.75$$ million; $$\$ 1.17$$ million; $$\$ 2$$ million; $$\$ 4.5$$ million; $$\$ 9.5$$ million
The limit does not exist; as the percent of pollutant to be removed approaches $$100$$ , the cost becomes astronomical.
